static family from the paired encoder build (2013.2) on the (2,45000,50000) descriptor, whose 30-pointer family is word-identical to the 6ch record of the same build: every statically hosted array (envelope ladder, remap curve offsets and both remap extensions) is byte-verified from the paired build. The ATH, octave, mask and interval surfaces have no static host in the image and are init-time materializations of deterministic geometry, produced by the paired build's psychoacoustic geometry materializer (a single routine at module offset 0x15ee0 of the build's conversion plug-in, image identity md5 d21427e9c35271d579205bc6fda8e325): a per-instruction port of that builder reproduces the registered 6ch bytes exactly on the 5-of-5 byte gates (ath, octave, mask_curve, interval_table 128/128 each; evidence chain in corpus/paired-build/the round/surface-init-spec.md, 6ch_rosetta_gate.json and root-verdict-r11a.md). Its transcendental calls are the build's own MSVCR90 imports (_CIlog/_CIexp/_CIatan); the on-disk carrier is Wine builtin, gate-proven equivalent on the registered 6ch inputs only, with real-Windows/real-CRT revalidation retained before any 2ch mechanism re-registration (the round; per-bin diffs in corpus/paired-build/the round/2ch_regen_diff.json). The registered 2ch values remain provisional operating points pending that re-registration. Per-field classification in corpus/paired-build/the round/artifacts/replacement-diff-table.json; provenance ledger in corpus/paired-build/the round/.

static family from the paired encoder build (2013.2): band-limit rows and blend weights are byte-verified against the paired build's channel-family tables. The 3x128 mask-curve rows are init-time materializations of deterministic geometry, reproduced 384/384 bytes exactly offline by the per-instruction port of the paired build's geometry materializer on the 6ch byte gate (root-verified); the earlier per-frame adaptive classification is refuted for these surfaces. The streamed-audio-driven runtime quantities are the transient detector's pair-mask and flag state, ported separately (corpus/paired-build/the round/short-mech-spec.md). Registered 2ch rows remain provisional operating points pending the round mechanism re-registration with the round real-CRT revalidation.

1024-bin curves, interval and profile words, seed curves, group labels and tone surfaces have no static host in the paired build. The earlier per-frame adaptive (streamed-audio-driven) classification is superseded by a root-verified data-signature audit: these surfaces carry exact deterministic-geometry structure (constant-width packed interval ramps, integer monotone ladders, cross-file byte identity between long-mode variant 2 and the long-base analysis set, outer struct identical except the sample-rate word), consistent with init-time materialization by the long-family counterpart of the geometry materializer; the mechanism port is the open task (the round, evidence in corpus/paired-build/the round/long-signature-audit.md). Current values are operating-point approximations (some shared bitwise with the 6ch registration via descriptor-pointer identity, some frequency-mapped) and are labeled provisional pending mechanism re-derivation.

the long-mode 2/3 analysis surfaces have no static host in the paired build; the per-frame adaptive classification is superseded by the root-verified deterministic-geometry signature audit (mode 2 is byte-identical to the long-base analysis set across both geometries). Current values are operating-point approximations (frequency-mapped from the 6ch registration) labeled provisional pending the long-family mechanism port (the round) and re-derivation.
